func TestCDNAuditExactPurgeCapacityCannotCompact(t *testing.T) {
 f := newFixture(t)
 repo, err := representation.NewIndexRepository(f.controls, f.bucket.ID(), func(ctx context.Context, loc string, id *object.ID) (*object.Metadata, error) { return f.bucket.Lookup(ctx, id) }, representation.WithBarrierLimit(2))
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 for _, raw := range []string{"https://example.com/a", "https://example.com/b"} {
  if err := repo.InvalidateURL(t.Context(), raw, representation.InvalidateHard); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 }
 compact, err := repo.CompactBarriers(t.Context(), 128)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 err = repo.InvalidateURL(t.Context(), "https://example.com/c", representation.InvalidateHard)
 t.Logf("catalog capacity=2, distinct PURGEs=3: compact removed=%d error=%v", compact.Removed, err)
 if compact.Removed != 0 || !errors.Is(err, storage.ErrInvalidationBudget) { t.Fatal("observed behavior changed") }
}

type cdnAuditReadBucket struct {
 storage.DurableRepresentationBucket
 opens int
 missingLast bool
}
func (b *cdnAuditReadBucket) ReadChunkFile(ctx context.Context, id *object.ID, index uint32) (storage.File, string, error) {
 b.opens++
 if b.missingLast && index == 3 { return nil, "", storage.ErrKeyNotFound }
 return b.DurableRepresentationBucket.ReadChunkFile(ctx, id, index)
}
func TestCDNAuditOneByteLookupOpensEveryChunk(t *testing.T) {
 f := diskFixture(t, "")
 probe := &cdnAuditReadBucket{DurableRepresentationBucket: f.bucket.(storage.DurableRepresentationBucket)}
 repo, err := representation.NewIndexRepository(f.controls, f.bucket.ID(), func(ctx context.Context, loc string, id *object.ID) (*object.Metadata, error) { return f.bucket.Lookup(ctx, id) }, representation.WithDurability(probe), representation.WithWriteback(), representation.WithClock(func() time.Time { return f.now }))
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 f.repo = repo
 ref, md := f.candidate(t, nil, nil, "audit", strings.Repeat("x", 64), f.now.Unix())
 md.Size = 256; md.Headers.Set("Content-Length", "256")
 for i := uint32(0); i < 4; i++ {
  writer, _, err := f.bucket.WriteChunkFile(t.Context(), md.ID, i)
  if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  if _, err := io.WriteString(writer, strings.Repeat("x", 64)); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  if err := writer.Close(); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  md.Chunks.Set(i)
 }
 commitCandidate(t, f, ref, md)
 probe.opens = 0
 selected, err := repo.LookupRead(t.Context(), f.key, http.Header{"Range": {"bytes=0-0"}})
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 selected.Lease.Close()
 t.Logf("1-byte Range lookup before reading response: opened chunks=%d of 4", probe.opens)
 if probe.opens != 4 { t.Fatal("observed behavior changed") }
 probe.opens = 0; probe.missingLast = true
 _, err = repo.LookupRead(t.Context(), f.key, http.Header{"Range": {"bytes=0-0"}})
 t.Logf("unrequested last chunk missing: first-byte lookup err=%v opened chunks=%d", err, probe.opens)
 if !errors.Is(err, storage.ErrKeyNotFound) { t.Fatal("observed behavior changed") }
}
